targets.name: veklom-backend
postBuild: docker run -d --name n13gp1nhrcdp0hvazvbnlxru-213557155694 --network coolify --env-file /data/coolify/applications/n13gp1nhrcdp0hvazvbnlxru/.env --restart unless-stopped veklom-local:latest
statusScripts: curl -sf http://localhost/health | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('API:', d.get('status','?'))" || echo 'API: DOWN'

targets.name: alembic-guard
targets.buildCommand: python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(['python','-m','alembic','-c','backend/db/migrations/alembic.ini','heads'],capture_output=True,text=True); heads=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if '(head)' in l]; count=len(heads); print(f'Alembic heads: {count}'); sys.exit(0 if count==1 else 1)"

targets.name: poltergeist-daemon
targets.buildCommand: echo 'Poltergeist InfrastructureSentinel is managed by the Python daemon. No build needed.'
statusScripts: curl -sf http://localhost/api/v1/gpc/status 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('GPC Queue:', d.get('queue_depth',0), 'pending')" || echo 'GPC: not reachable'

targets.name: repogate
targets.buildCommand: echo 'Repogate runs as a router inside veklom-backend. Validate its routes are healthy.'
statusScripts: curl -sf http://localhost/api/v1/repogate/status 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Repogate:', d.get('status','?'))" || echo 'Repogate: not reachable'
